title: Next Greater Element I
statement:
Given an array A of N integers, for each element find the first greater element to its right. If no such element exists, output -1 for that element.

Print the space-separated output array.

Use a monotonic stack to solve this in O(N) time.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: N space-separated integers on a single line.

examples.explanation: Right of 4 is 5. Right of 5 is 10. Right of 2 is 10. Right of 10 is none (-1).
No elements have a greater element to their right.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
ans = [-1] * n
# Write your solution using a monotonic stack
print(*ans)
